name: Merp

notable_features: Burn scar in the shape of a claw on his forearm
Wild, untamed beard tied with bone beads

ideals: Knowledge should be shared, even when dangerous
Every creature has a role—even the monstrous
flaws: Lacks common sense in practical combat situations
personality.bond: His old mentor was devoured by a mimic while protecting Merp's first field notes—he now wears the mentor’s rune-etched belt at all times.
personality.motivation: To compile the first truly comprehensive Field Bestiary of World A and clear his mentor’s name of academic fraud

background.origin_story: Born to stonecutters in Mt. Duegar, Merp never had the patience for masonry. Fascinated by cave-dwelling beasts, he began recording monster behavior on the backs of mining ledgers. After being dismissed as eccentric, he left home and studied under the famed (but disgraced) monsterologist Thandor Bristlehide.
family: Older Sister: Hilda (councilwoman of Mt. Duegar)
notable_events: Tricked a chimera into falling off a cliff using polished mirrors
Discovered a previously undocumented parasitic slime inside a sand wyrm’s skull
Accidentally healed a goblin warlord who then declared Merp a 'tribe cousin'
background.current_goal: Track down a sentient ooze species rumored to mimic humanoid thought

dislikes: People who say 'it’s just a monster'
fears: Losing his research to fire or theft
hobbies: Singing dwarven lullabies to confused beasts
religion_or_beliefs: Follows the Stonemother, a dwarven earth-goddess of knowledge, protection, and deep patience. Prays before major expeditions by burying a stone with a carved rune.

allies: Greel the Hobgoblin herbalist (trades monster toxins)
Sister Fela – a cleric who heals Merp more often than she'd like
rivals: Professor Belvast Runehelm – former classmate who stole Merp’s ooze theory
relationships.romantic_interest: Mild, awkward crush on a cyclopean archivist named Vira who speaks only in hand-signs

inventory: Antivenom necklace (chews a bead when poisoned)
Reinforced satchel with extra-planar storage compartment
pets_or_companions: A domesticated cave mole named Snortle who alerts him to vibrations
secrets: Once disguised himself as a kobold to infiltrate a dragon cult—and kind of liked it
His real thesis was ghostwritten by a banshee in exchange for a memory crystal
quotes: Now hold still—I just need to compare your bite radius to a barghest.
I may be screaming, but I am learning!
Ooh, that mucus coloration is *not* in the literature!
theme_music: Chaotic woodwind and percussion mix—playful, scholarly, slightly off-kilter (think Danny Elfman meets Baldur's Gate tavern ambience)
